title: NEB Class 12 Mathematics — Differential Equations — 2024
subject: mathematics
source: NEB Grade 12 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Solve dy/dx + y/x = x².
questions.solution:
This is linear, dy/dx + Py = Q with P = 1/x, Q = x².

Integrating factor IF = e^(∫P dx) = e^(lnx) = x.

Multiplying through: x·dy/dx + y = x³, i.e. d(xy)/dx = x³.

Integrating: xy = x⁴/4 + C, so **y = x³/4 + C/x**.
questions.knowledgeNote: The integrating factor always makes the left side collapse into the derivative of (IF × y) — check this before integrating.

questions.question: Solve the differential equation dy/dx = (1 + y²)/(1 + x²).
questions.solution:
The variables separate:

dy/(1 + y²) = dx/(1 + x²).

Integrating both sides: tan⁻¹y = tan⁻¹x + C.

**General solution:** tan⁻¹y − tan⁻¹x = C (equivalently (y − x)/(1 + xy) = tan C after applying the difference formula).
questions.knowledgeNote: Recognise the separable form first; standard integrals ∫dx/(1 + x²) = tan⁻¹x are the whole content of the question.

questions.question: Write the order and degree of the differential equation (d²y/dx²)² + (dy/dx)³ = 0.
questions.solution:
**Order** = the order of the highest derivative present = **2** (d²y/dx²).

**Degree** = the power of the highest-order derivative when the equation is polynomial in derivatives = **(d²y/dx²)² has power 2**, so degree = 2.

The equation is thus of order 2 and degree 2 (it is not linear, since it contains the square of the second derivative).
questions.knowledgeNote: Degree is read only after clearing radicals and fractions in the derivatives — always rewrite in polynomial form before reading it off.
